test_image_instantiation: test the Image feature class instantiation and verify its default dtype, pa_type, and _type attributes
test_image_encode_example: test the Image.encode_example method to encode various input formats including paths, bytes, and dicts into a standardized dict
test_image_decode_example: test the Image.decode_example method to decode image dicts or paths into PIL.Image.Image objects with EXIF orientation support
test_dataset_with_image_feature: test creating a Dataset with an Image feature column and verify item, batch, and column access return PIL.Image.Image instances
test_encode_np_array: test the encode_np_array function to convert numpy arrays of supported dtypes into encoded image dicts with path and bytes fields
